shopping-materialist.config.generic.name: ctrlClickAmount
shopping-materialist.config.generic.comm: How many items Ctrl+click adds or removes in the shopping list editor (2 - 256). In the editor, Ctrl + mouse wheel changes it.
shopping-materialist.config.generic.name: wanderingTraderButton
shopping-materialist.config.generic.comm:
Adds a 'Shopping list' button to the wandering trader's trading screen.
It fills the 'Wandering Trader' shopping list with all items needed for every trade
that is not sold out yet (e.g. the blocks and emeralds for Vanilla Tweaks' mini block trades)
and shows it in Litematica's info HUD.
shopping-materialist.config.generic.name: villagerButton
shopping-materialist.config.generic.comm:
Adds a 'Shopping list' button to the villager trading screen.
It fills the 'Villager' shopping list with all items needed for every trade
that is not sold out yet and shows it in Litematica's info HUD.
shopping-materialist.config.generic.name: wanderingTraderNewList
shopping-materialist.config.generic.comm:
If enabled, the wandering trader's 'Shopping list' button creates a new list
(Wandering Trader, Wandering Trader_2, Wandering Trader_3...) instead of overwriting the 'Wandering Trader' list.
shopping-materialist.config.generic.name: villagerNewList
shopping-materialist.config.generic.comm:
If enabled, the villager's 'Shopping list' button creates a new list
(Villager, Villager_2, Villager_3...) instead of overwriting the 'Villager' list.
shopping-materialist.config.generic.name: materialListNewList
shopping-materialist.config.generic.comm:
If enabled, 'Edit items' on a schematic placement or area analysis material list
creates a new list (name, name_2, name_3...) instead of overwriting the list with the same name.
